title: Vance-Led Task Force to Remove 760,000 Enrollees From ACA Coverage Over Fraud Claims
detail: Vice President JD Vance, who leads the White House Task Force to Eliminate Fraud, announced Tuesday, September 23, 2026, that the administration is cancelling roughly 315,000 Affordable Care Act enrollments covering about 760,000 people, alleging many were fraudulently enrolled, ineligible, or simply do not exist, in part because the government was not verifying enrollee eligibility. Vance said the action would save taxpayers about $2.2 billion and that a further 419,000 enrollments would face additional verification; officials also announced a six-month suspension on new insurance agents and brokers signing up ACA enrollees, saying brokers commit a disproportionate share of the fraud uncovered. Roughly 19.2 million Americans are enrolled in ACA marketplace plans as of early 2026, and Democratic lawmakers and healthcare advocates warned the mass cancellations would strip coverage from people who are in fact eligible and drive up premiums.

media.caption: Vice President JD Vance announced a task force would remove 760,000 people from ACA coverage over alleged fraud, saving a projected $2.2 billion

title: Xi Jinping Arrives in Washington for First US State Visit in Nearly Three Years; Trump Greets Him on the Tarmac
detail: Chinese President Xi Jinping and his wife, Peng Liyuan, landed at Joint Base Andrews on Wednesday, September 23, 2026, opening a three-day state visit — Xi's first trip to the US in nearly three years — with Trump breaking from protocol to personally greet the couple planeside rather than waiting at the White House. First Lady Melania Trump said the airport reception reflected the two leaders' 'great relationship'; Trump had invited Xi during his own state visit to China in May 2026. The visit continues Thursday with a formal White House arrival ceremony, a Rose Garden troop review, a summit meeting and a black-tie state dinner in the East Room featuring tech executives including Nvidia's Jensen Huang and SpaceX's Elon Musk, before a Friday tea and a joint visit to the National Archives. Analysts said the talks were likely to yield incremental progress on trade and AI rather than a breakthrough, with a temporary US-China trade truce due to expire in November.

media.caption: Chinese President Xi Jinping arrives at Joint Base Andrews for a three-day state visit, greeted on the tarmac by President Trump

title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico Face Off With DOJ in Court Over White House Ban
detail: US District Judge Timothy Kelly heard arguments Wednesday afternoon, September 23, 2026, in the First Amendment lawsuit CNN, MS NOW and Politico filed after Trump barred them from White House grounds. The Justice Department told the court that 'access to the White House is a privilege — not a right,' arguing Trump has authority to restrict which outlets can enter and citing national security concerns; the three outlets countered that the ban is 'a direct assault on the First Amendment' and asked the judge to immediately restore their access. More than 45 news organizations — including NBC News, the AP, CBS, Fox News, NPR and the New York Times — filed supporting briefs arguing the ban constitutes unconstitutional viewpoint discrimination. Judge Kelly, a 2017 Trump nominee who ordered the White House to restore CNN's Jim Acosta in a similar 2018 dispute, did not rule from the bench.

media.caption: CNN, MS NOW and Politico argued in court that the White House ban violates the First Amendment; DOJ called access to the White House 'a privilege, not a right'
